sentence: This project studies the shapes of RNA pieces in enteroviruses and how they help the virus copy its genome.
This project builds computer tools that predict groundwater flow and also report how uncertain those predictions are.
This project develops ways to quickly separate the parts of complex mixtures by sending them through very thin capillaries.
This project builds augmented reality and virtual reality tools for exploring electric and magnetic fields in 3D.
This project uses algebra to study equations and to measure how smooth or pointy a curve or surface is.
This project studies how localized curvatures change the way slender beams behave, using a computer model and experiments.
This project studies how growing temperature affects the genes that help pepper and tomato plants resist disease-causing pathogens.
This project designs a computer system that learns to spot signs of network weakness and judge how serious an attack is.
This project builds a nanopore biosensor that finds signs of infectious diseases in human blood at a low cost.
This project studies how adding noise to protect private data changes how accurate and reliable learning from that data is.
This project builds superconductor materials and devices that can hold quantum information in pairs of Majorana zero modes.
This project studies how plant genes and the environment together shape the fungi living in leaves and how those fungi protect against disease.
This project studies how the different worldviews of decision-makers shape the way frozen landscapes of ice, snow and permafrost are governed.
This project studies what happens inside metal as it is rolled while being 3D printed, to improve the strength of printed metal parts.
This project uses genome data to find out whether tarantula species on sky islands evolved once or many times.
